name: Busa Money
description: Aggregated money ledger across Mercury, Stripe, Airwallex, and Creem

agentPrompts.label: Give me the money overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-money` skill in this folder, then give me the money command-desk view — account health, top-level inflow/outflow/fees/net, and recent money movement.

agentPrompts.label: Sync all my accounts
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-money` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then propose a read-only sync scope across Mercury, Stripe, Airwallex, and Creem for my approval, and after I approve, fetch, normalize, and write the ledger into Busabase.

agentPrompts.label: Show me this account in detail
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-money` skill in this folder, then show me the account I name in detail — balances, recent transactions, counterparties, statuses, and sync health.

agentPrompts.label: What needs reconciliation?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-money` skill in this folder, then open the invoice reconciliation desk and summarize what's missing a match, mismatched in amount, or waiting on my review.
